operations.summary: Get the runbook for one multi-tool playbook.
operations.notes: Read-only, and answered by this server — it makes no call on your behalf and changes nothing. A playbook is a chain of tools that only finishes the job together: it names the steps in order, what each step needs from the step before it, what is left unfinished if you stop partway, and what to do when a step fails. Call this before starting a chain, and again if you lose track of where you are in one. Response: {name, title, when_to_use, entry_operation, done_when, steps: [...], body}. Each step carries its position (`step` of `of`), the `operation_id` to call, its `goal`, the `next` operations, and — where they apply — `requires` (which input comes from which earlier response), `incomplete_alone` (what stays broken if you stop there) and `on_failure` (whether the step may be retried blind, what it may have left behind, and which read operation establishes whether it landed). `body` is the markdown runbook: polling cadence, status meanings and the recovery table.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The playbook to fetch. The allowed values are the registered playbooks.
